AboutText:
eboard is the latest prototype for the fluid ui concept. it aims at helping users to relax, to organize,
to start or continue project work or every day personal activity.
it is divided into context areas, identifiable by right click context menus with 'fluid ui' menu item.
you can change some design properties for each context area separately and therefor change any 
part of eboard within minutes completely. plugins allow for easy addition of functionalities.
you can have many eboard screens and navigate them in the browser. each eboard screen can have
a multitude of plugin elements. a plugin is a context area, that surrounds a function or feature.
plugins can have a context menu, but are not required to.
